source_issue.title: Metadata block or easy way to insert document metadata inside text block

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses the need for a new feature in Plone called a "metadata block." This block will allow users to insert document metadata (like publishing dates and tags) directly into text blocks. It aims to enhance the dynamic capabilities of pages by making metadata more accessible and usable.

## What needs to be done
We need to develop a block or button that integrates this metadata functionality into the existing text block editor. Discussions suggest that incorporating a "mention" feature could be beneficial, allowing users to easily insert metadata throughout their content.

## Helpful background
Current discussions show varying opinions on whether this feature should be included in the core of Volto. While some contributors recommend adding metadata capabilities, there are concerns about bloating the core with additional blocks. Existing add-ons can provide similar functionality, but integrating it more seamlessly might improve user experience.

## Good first steps
1. Review the existing branch: [eea-metadata-mentions](https://github.com/plone/volto/tree/eea-metadata-mentions).
2. Familiarize yourself with similar add-ons: [volto-metadata-block](https://github.com/eea/volto-metadata-block) and [volto-slate-metadata-mentions](https://github.com/eea/volto-slate-metadata-mentions).
3. Engage in discussions for clarity and to share your thoughts on the proposed features.
4. Collaborate with peers for potential testing, documentation, or code reviews.
```
